value.account:
CHANGED. state.py: optional RunState.result_persistence_profile (omitted when absent, ValueError on any other value at construction, initialize() and load; a failed load leaves the file untouched). Atomic StateManager methods begin_eligible_pure_visit, reuse_interrupted_eligible_pure_visit, settle_eligible_pure_success and settle_eligible_pure_failure, written as shared helpers so the call-frame manager has the same methods. New modules: pure_replay_witness.py (shell, validate, classify_pure_replay_progress, PureResultReplayIndexError with error_payload), pure_replay_index.py (derive_pure_result_replay_index, typed-literal checking, cycle and projection-identity checks), and pure_result_replay.py (PureReplayRuntime: cache, overlay, replay_node, boundary audits, persisted-surface conflict audit). OutcomeRecorder.persist_step_result gained eligible_pure_settlement. call_frame_state has load_existing_call_frame_read_only and rejects a malformed existing frame before any write. Fresh Workflow Lisp child frames select the profile from the callee's provenance; calls made from iteration scopes stay historical. `orchestrator run` of a compiled .orc and `resume --force-restart` of an .orc select the profile. Executor: eligible pure steps use begin/reuse for the visit (no start_step), skip the pure bundle, settle through the shell, and keep the full result in memory. Resume audits surfaces and visit progress before the prologue, then replays only the nodes the restart boundary needs, and fails the run with pure_result_replay_unavailable plus a reason. The restart node is determined once per resume and passed to ResumePlanner.determine_default_resume_decision(restart_node_id=...). The provider observation manager is now created when execute() starts. Eligible pure points emit no checkpoint record and are omitted from restore payload bindings. The default-resume nearest-prior-boundary search excludes them, and the zero-record VALIDATED_FRAME_ENTRY_REPLAY case is added. specs/state.md documents the profile. Tests: tests/test_pure_result_replay.py (11 tests, including an interrupted-resume run that makes no second call). I updated tests/test_provider_observation_workflow.py to the new manager timing and loosened three stubs in test_subworkflow_calls.py and one in test_workflow_lisp_phased_delivery_runtime.py to accept the new restart_node_id keyword.

ALTERNATIVES. I considered centralising the profile in the executor and discarded it, since the shell has to be settled by the state manager transaction. I put early skip and failure rows on the same path as success by starting the visit lazily in _persist_step_result, instead of patching each of the many early-persist sites. I discarded a literal propagation of ineligibility across pure dependencies, because durable rows of a loop node are legitimate inputs to a later single-visit node. The default-resume decision is fed durable state rather than the in-memory overlay, so overlay rows never stand in for durable authority.

NOT COVERED / UNCERTAIN. The replay_node evaluate_node callable signature (node_id, overlay_state) -> result dict, the resolve_bundle_path argument (node id) and the load_existing_call_frame_read_only return type (RunState) are my guesses where the spec was silent. Scope kind: any scope_kind other than "root" raises dependency_index_invalid with expected_scope/actual_scope; I treat every bundle as scope "root". The boundary seed scan finds downstream pure needs by walking typed addresses and text, so refs hidden elsewhere could be missed. Not tested: union-row validation, reachability_ambiguous, wrong-typed intrinsic checks, the force-restart and CLI selection, retry-after-failed-predecessor selection, checkpoint_record/restore_payload/pure_bundle/private-lineage conflicts, the 'resume after completed run' case (re-entering a completed profiled run reports progress_witness_invalid), and the 'without a durable owner' wording of the zero-record rule (I read it as: witness or leaf validation failing gives FAIL_CLOSED not_restorable). The unmodified tree already fails 158 tests (environment and sandbox related). With my changes the only extra failure in the full-suite diff that remained was a flaky symlink test, which passed when re-run. The earlier timing-test breakages I fixed as above.
value.summary: Implemented the derived_pure_replay.v1 profile end to end: state selector, value-free shells with atomic visit transactions, replay index and in-memory replay at resume, checkpoint filtering and the frame-entry default resume. Several checks in the spec's detailed list are not covered or not tested.
